aerial_damage_per_mile_year.unit: per mile of aerial span per year, in still air
aerial_damage_per_mile_year.note: Limbs, ice and vehicles on aerial plant; no published rate was found. Wind raises it (wind_damage_exponent).

agents_per_10000_homes.unit: agents on shift per 10,000 homes served, 07:00 to 21:00

call_delay_min.unit: minutes, mean, from noticing to calling, while awake
call_delay_min.note: Judgement. Nobody calls between 23:00 and 07:00; a call that would has to wait for the morning.

call_share_out.unit: share of homes out that call
call_share_out.note: A utility roundtable slide put the share of customers who report a power outage at about 15 %; its page is gone and couldn't be read to confirm, and an internet outage isn't measured. Judgement until a source is read.

call_share_slow.unit: share of homes with poor service that call
call_share_slow.note: Judgement: far fewer call about slow service than about none.

callback_hours.unit: hours, mean, before a household still out after its call calls again
callback_hours.note: Judgement: people call back when nothing changes.

connector_wear_per_span_year.note: A connector loosening or corroding until it reflects, over days.

dig_ins_per_underground_mile_year.unit: per mile of buried span per year
dig_ins_per_underground_mile_year.note: CGA's DIRT report counts about 2 excavation damages per 1,000 locate requests, about half of them telecom; how many requests fall on a mile of buried coax isn't published, so this is judgement.

drive_mph.unit: miles per hour along the streets

escalate_after_tickets.unit: tickets on one node, with a truck already sent, before dispatch sends a line crew to what they share
escalate_after_tickets.note: Judgement: how dispatch without a twin groups calls into an outage.

fiber_cuts_per_mile_year.unit: per mile of fiber cable per year

handle_min.note: Telecom average handle time, 8 minutes 48 seconds, against 5:24 for retail, from a Cornell report relayed by Call Centre Helper; the page says neither is dated at its source.

line_trucks_per_10000_homes.unit: line crews with bucket trucks per 10,000 homes, 07:00 to 19:00
line_trucks_per_10000_homes.note: Judgement; one on call at night.

patience_min.unit: minutes, mean, a caller waits before giving up

plant_downtime_minutes_per_home_year.note: HFC downtime from causes other than AC power (amplifier failure, water, cable cuts), 125 minutes a line a year beside 622 from AC power, as a search summary of this patent gave it; the patent is a scanned image and wasn't read to confirm. A check on the plant rates, not one the world draws from.

rain_factor_per_mm_hr.unit: added to the dry rate's multiplier per mm/h of rain

redial_min.unit: minutes, mean, before a caller who gave up tries again while still out

repair_active_min.unit: minutes on site: an amplifier or node module swapped

repair_aerial_min.unit: minutes on site: an aerial span cut, re-spliced from a bucket
repair_aerial_min.note: Judgement, between the quick and the buried repairs.

repair_cable_min.unit: minutes on site: a buried span cut, found and spliced
repair_cable_min.note: About 8 hours for section analysis, digging and the repair of a bad cable, the same author's estimate from training a large telco's technicians.

repair_fiber_min.unit: minutes on site: a fiber cut found and spliced

repair_quick_min.unit: minutes on site: a drop, a connector, a tap
repair_quick_min.note: About 2 hours of technician time to restore service quickly, an outside-plant engineer's estimate for one case, which he calls a guess from 45 years in the industry.

service_trucks_per_10000_homes.note: Judgement; one on call at night.

storm_outage_hours.note: Customers averaged about 5.5 hours without power in 2022 against about 2 outside major events (EIA), so most of the hours come in storms; 6 hours for one outage in a storm is judgement, not a measured mean.

tap_corrosion_per_tap_year.note: A tap corroding: mismatch and CPD with no blow.

twin_reading_delay_min.unit: minutes from a step to the twin's reading of it
twin_reading_delay_min.note: Collection and diagnosis time, so a reading never sits inside a step.

utility_outage_hours.note: Outside major events customers have averaged about two hours a year without power since 2013 (EIA), over about 1.4 outages: about 1.4 hours each, taken as 1.5. A storm's outages last longer (storm_outage_hours).

utility_outages_per_home_year.note: The U.S. average in 2022, 1.4 outages per customer (SAIFI), from the EIA's report on that year.

vehicle_hits_per_structure_year.unit: per pole or pedestal per year
vehicle_hits_per_structure_year.note: A car into a pole or a pedestal. No published rate for cable plant was found.

water_per_device_year.unit: per tap, amp or node per year, in dry weather
water_per_device_year.note: Water inside a housing; rain raises it.

water_per_span_year.unit: per span per year, in dry weather
water_per_span_year.note: Water in a span's cable; rain raises it (rain_factor_per_mm_hr).

wind_damage_exponent.unit: power of wind speed over 8 m/s
wind_damage_exponent.note: Damage rises steeply with wind above a gale: the aerial rate is multiplied by 1 + (wind / 8 m/s)^4. Judgement.
